fields.after: A7 (2026-11-20), owner decision C11: a shared base. Its two track-thickness records are pinned to color-control.json by their legacy keys and are referenced by color-slider and color-wheel, so they cannot move. No container and no recipe; no Figma, RSP or SWC source draws it on its own.
